headline: DeadLands and Lykos Isle Roil; Fishermans Row Quiet
war_summary: Fresh dispatches from the midday line show DeadLands and Lykos Isle seizing the battle's tempo. DeadLands has logged three strategic-base actions in the past two hours and seven in six, bringing its daily tally to eleven, with The Salt March and Callahan's Boot changing hands repeatedly. Lykos Isle, once quiet, has posted two actions in the last two hours—the latest within the hour—and eleven in the day, with Fort Guile the focus. Fishermans Row, yesterday's storm center, has gone quiet in the last two hours after a busy morning; its six-hour count still stands at seven actions, and the day's total at twenty-eight. Linn Mercy has not recorded a fresh flip since 02:35, though its casualty ledgers remain heavy. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle have posted no new actions, though their 24-hour histories remain substantial. Elsewhere, Weathered Expanse grinds on with fierce losses but no change of flag, and Clahstra shows accelerating casualty rates on both sides on the war's sixty-eighth day.
